description: Defines classes and functions for converting internal IR representations to JSON, including JSON wrapper classes, constants, and enum-to-string mappings.

classes.name: JsonArray
classes.description: Wrapper class for JSON array values, inherits from Json::Value.

classes.name: JsonObject
classes.description: Wrapper class for JSON object values, inherits from Json::Value, with methods to set key-value pairs with omissible values.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair in JsonObject, omitting the key if the value is the default.

methods.name: SetOmissible
methods.description: Template method to set a key-value pair if the value is not equal to the omissible value.
